description.value:
A versatile ranged and melee combatant skilled with a wide array of weapons and baseline combat maneuvers. The Fighter is the galaxy's consummate soldier — equally comfortable behind a blaster rifle, a vibroblade, or the controls of a walker — and relies on hard-won training rather than the Force or exotic technology to win the day.

Fighters draw on a shared pool of battlefield Maneuvers to trip up, disarm, rally, or outmaneuver their foes, and further hone their approach to war through a personal set of Strategies as they gain experience, letting the class flex from a frontline juggernaut to a precision marksman without ever needing a second class.
